title: Arrearage Management Program Fact Sheet — Forgiveness Terms Across Payment Arrangement Kinds
content:
# Arrearage Management Program Fact Sheet — Forgiveness Terms Across Payment Arrangement Kinds

Of the seven kinds of Payment Arrangement, only the Arrearage Management Program forgives arrears; every other kind is a repayment plan. The forgiveness terms of each kind are:

| Arrangement kind | Share of each scheduled installment forgiven when the current bill is paid in full by its due date | When forgiveness is posted | Lifetime ceiling on arrears forgiven per customer | Withheld forgiveness restored once the late bill is paid in full |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payment Extension | 0% | Not applicable | $0.00 | No |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 0% | Not applicable | $0.00 | No |
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | 0% | Not applicable | $0.00 | No |
| Extended Deferred Payment Agreement | 0% | Not applicable | $0.00 | No |
| Winter Protection Plan | 0% | Not applicable | $0.00 | No |
| Arrearage Management Program | 100% | Posted on the day after the due date of the bill whose current charges were paid in full by that due date | $8000.00 | Yes |
| Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement | 0% | Not applicable | $0.00 | No |

## About the program terms

- **Share forgiven**: the fraction of each scheduled installment forgiven, instead of billed, when the current bill is paid in full by its due date. In the Arrearage Management Program the share is 100%, the whole scheduled installment.
- **Lifetime ceiling**: the ceiling applies to the arrears forgiven across all of a customer's Arrearage Management Program plans, not to one plan.
- **Restoring withheld forgiveness**: in the Arrearage Management Program, forgiveness withheld for a late current bill can be restored once that bill is paid in full.

## Example (hypothetical dates)

A program bill dated March 4 falls due on March 25 and its current charges are paid in full on March 22. Under the posting term in the table, the forgiveness for the installment that bill carries is posted on March 26, the day after the due date.
